_comment: The fully crossed grid the pilot is a subset of. Not run yet — shipped so the capability is demonstrably present and so the pilot config can be diffed against it. Swap the model ids for an eligible tier before running (see _models).

_design.crossing: A x B fully crossed is the contribution: Architecture Matters (arXiv:2604.23459) explicitly notes its own axes were varied independently without systematic crossing. The four orgs below are that crossing at one composition; add C and D by duplicating with the model set or deliberation_rounds changed.
_design.cells: A x B = 4 (below). A x B x C = 8. A x B x C x D = 16.

_models: Cheap paid heterogeneous trio (Mistral / Qwen / Google), matching the pilot so the two are diffable. These are non-reasoning models and would likely fail the eligibility gate — replace with a tier that clears it before treating any output as results.
